newsitem.title: VATICAN: Vatican fears 12 Rwandan clerics killed in Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Vatican fears 12 Rwandan clerics killed in Zaire.

text.p: The Vatican's radio station said on Wednesday it had unconfirmed reports that nine Rwandan priests and three nuns were killed in Zaire last month.
Vatican Radio said the 12, all Rwandans, were feared killed in the eastern town of Kalima under Tutsi rebel control.
They had come from Bukavu on the Rwandan border and had asked to go to Kasongo, near Kalima, but had not been able to travel because of a lack of vehicles.
Tutsi-led rebels have seized a vast stretch of eastern Zaire since taking up arms last October.
Guerrilla leader Laurent Kabila says he is determined to end ailing Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko's 31-year rule.
He has spurned international pressure for a ceasefire, insisting on direct negotiations with Mobutu, who is at present in France.
